# logic constraint member

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/logicConstraintMember>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

A member constraint combined by a logical constraint ([odrl:operand](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/operand)). Non-functional: a logical constraint combines two or more.
